vulnerability_summary: x402 SIWX settlement hooks assumed paymentPayload.resource was always present and dereferenced resource.url, despite the v2 protocol making resource optional.
causality: Human atomic commit 03199d960398b739255966cb21ee9f7b7dec87ae creates hooks.ts, declares resource as required, and introduces the exact `new URL(ctx.paymentPayload.resource.url)` dereference with no AI signal. Claude-coauthored commit 8c15e97cb72caea7fe85e966c0f415b61afe4032 later edits the same file but leaves that vulnerable type and dereference unchanged. Squash fe42994900a445155be7a697de060c5a34f36a2d has broad Claude trailers spanning many decomposed commits; those trailers cannot transfer authorship to the human atomic origin. Fix 1ab1c86f016161f27593bf17c9a2333c2201ab10 makes resource optional and returns when the URL is absent.
